private void addContainsBegin() throws IOException {
    add("  private abstract static class ContainsPredicate extends DelegatingValueInspector {\n"
        + "    ContainsPredicate(ValueInspector... delegates) {\n"
        + "      super(delegates);\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    abstract ContainsPredicate not();\n"
        + "  }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "  private static class ContainsSinglePredicate extends ContainsPredicate {\n"
        + "    private final boolean isNot;\n"
        + " \n"
        + "    private ContainsSinglePredicate(ValueInspector inspector, boolean isNot) {\n"
        + "      super(inspector);\n"
        + "      this.isNot = isNot;\n"
        + "    }\n\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    ContainsPredicate not() {\n"
        + "      return new ContainsSinglePredicate(getDelegates().iterator().next(), true);\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    void onUpdate() {\n"
        + "      if (isKnown()) {\n"
        + "        return;\n"
        + "      }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "      for (ValueInspector inspector : getDelegates()) {\n"
        + "        if (inspector.isKnown() && inspector.getResult()) {\n"
        + "          setResult(!isNot);\n"
        + "          return;\n"
        + "        }\n"
        + "      }\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    void onNull() {\n"
        + "      setResult(isNot);\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "  }\n\n");

    add("  private static class ContainsAndPredicate extends ContainsPredicate {\n"
        + "    private ContainsAndPredicate(ContainsPredicate left, ContainsPredicate right) {\n"
        + "      super(left, right);\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    void onUpdate() {\n"
        + "      if (isKnown()) { return; }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "      boolean allKnown = true;\n"
        + "      for (ValueInspector delegate : getDelegates()) {\n"
        + "        if (delegate.isKnown() && !delegate.getResult()) {\n"
        + "          setResult(false);\n"
        + "          return;\n"
        + "        }\n"
        + "        allKnown = allKnown && delegate.isKnown();\n"
        + "      }\n"
        + "      \n"
        + "      if (allKnown) {\n"
        + "        setResult(true);\n"
        + "      }\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    void onNull() {\n"
        + "      for (ValueInspector delegate : getDelegates()) {\n"
        + "        if (!delegate.getResult()) {\n"
        + "          setResult(false);\n"
        + "          return;\n"
        + "        }\n"
        + "      }\n"
        + "      setResult(true);\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    ContainsPredicate not() {\n"
        + "      Iterator<ValueInspector> it = getDelegates().iterator();\n"
        + "      return new ContainsAndPredicate(((ContainsPredicate) it.next()).not(), ((ContainsPredicate) it.next()).not());\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "  }\n\n");

    add("  private static class ContainsOrPredicate extends ContainsPredicate {\n"
        + "    private ContainsOrPredicate(ContainsPredicate left, ContainsPredicate right) {\n"
        + "      super(left, right);\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    void onUpdate() {\n"
        + "      if (isKnown()) { return; }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "      for (ValueInspector delegate : getDelegates()) {\n"
        + "        if (delegate.isKnown() && delegate.getResult()) {\n"
        + "          setResult(true);\n"
        + "        }\n"
        + "      }\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    void onNull() {\n"
        + "      for (ValueInspector delegate : getDelegates()) {\n"
        + "        if (delegate.getResult()) {\n"
        + "          setResult(true);\n"
        + "          return;\n"
        + "        }\n"
        + "      }\n"
        + "      setResult(false);\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    ContainsPredicate not() {\n"
        + "      Iterator<ValueInspector> it = getDelegates().iterator();\n"
        + "      return new ContainsOrPredicate(((ContainsPredicate) it.next()).not(), ((ContainsPredicate) it.next()).not());\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "  }\n\n");

    add("  private class ContainsInspectorVisitor implements FilterPredicate.Visitor<ContainsPredicate> {\n\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    public <T extends Comparable<T>> ContainsPredicate visit(Contains<T> contains) {\n"
        + "      return contains.filter(this, ContainsAndPredicate::new, ContainsOrPredicate::new, ContainsPredicate::not);\n"
        + "    }\n");

    addContainsInspectorVisitor("Eq");
    addContainsInspectorVisitor("NotEq");
    addContainsInspectorVisitor("Lt");
    addContainsInspectorVisitor("LtEq");
    addContainsInspectorVisitor("Gt");
    addContainsInspectorVisitor("GtEq");
    addContainsInspectorVisitor("In");
    addContainsInspectorVisitor("NotIn");

    add("    @Override\n"
        + "    public ContainsPredicate visit(Operators.And pred) {\n"
        + "      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(\"Operators.And not supported for Contains predicate\");\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    public ContainsPredicate visit(Operators.Or pred) {\n"
        + "      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(\"Operators.Or not supported for Contains predicate\");\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    public ContainsPredicate visit(Operators.Not pred) {\n"
        + "      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(\"Operators.Not not supported for Contains predicate\");\n"
        + "    }"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    public <T extends Comparable<T>, U extends UserDefinedPredicate<T>> ContainsPredicate visit(\n"
        + "        UserDefined<T, U> pred) {\n"
        + "      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(\"UserDefinedPredicate not supported for Contains predicate\");\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "\n"
        + "    @Override\n"
        + "    public <T extends Comparable<T>, U extends UserDefinedPredicate<T>> ContainsPredicate visit(\n"
        + "        LogicalNotUserDefined<T, U> pred) {\n"
        + "      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(\"LogicalNotUserDefined not supported for Contains predicate\");\n"
        + "    }\n"
        + "  }\n"
        + "\n");
  }

Functional Description:
The `run` method generates Java code for a class that implements various filter predicates based on the Parquet file format. It constructs the class definition and methods for handling equality, inequality, and user-defined predicates, writing the generated code to a specified file through a `FileWriter`. The method collaborates with various helper methods to build specific cases for different predicate types.

Args:
None

Returns:
None - The function does not return a value.

Preconditions:
- The `FileWriter` must be successfully initialized in the constructor of `IncrementallyUpdatedFilterPredicateGenerator` to avoid `IOException`.

Postconditions:
- A new Java class definition for `IncrementallyUpdatedFilterPredicateBuilder` is written to the specified file, including methods for handling various filter predicates. The file is closed after writing.

Invariants:
None

Exception:
- Throws `IOException` if an I/O error occurs during writing to the file.
bug_summary: The generated Eq and NotEq visitor methods are associated with the opposite predicate logic. This causes equality predicates to behave as inequality predicates and vice versa in the generated builder.

suite_diagnostics.reason: test compile repair returned no change

validation_result.reason: The boolean argument distinguishing equality from inequality is reversed for the Eq and NotEq visitors. Consequently, an Eq predicate is generated with NotEq semantics and a NotEq predicate with Eq semantics. For example, a predicate requiring column value 5 would incorrectly match values other than 5, producing observable filtering differences.

specification:
Functional Description:
The `fromParquetMetadata` method converts a `FileMetaData` object representing Parquet metadata into a `ParquetMetadata` object, which includes block metadata and schema information. It processes row groups and column chunks, handling both plaintext and encrypted columns, and manages decryption where necessary.

Args:
- `parquetMetadata` (FileMetaData): The metadata of the Parquet file, which includes schema and row group information. Must not be null.
- `fileDecryptor` (InternalFileDecryptor): An object responsible for decrypting encrypted columns. Can be null if the file is not encrypted.
- `encryptedFooter` (boolean): Indicates whether the footer of the Parquet file is encrypted. Affects how metadata is processed.
- `rowGroupToRowIndexOffsetMap` (Map<RowGroup, Long>): A mapping of row groups to their respective row index offsets. Must not be null.

Returns:
ParquetMetadata - A `ParquetMetadata` object containing the file metadata and a list of block metadata. The returned object reflects the structure and encryption status of the input metadata.

Preconditions:
- `parquetMetadata` must not be null.
- `rowGroupToRowIndexOffsetMap` must not be null.
- If `fileDecryptor` is provided, it must be properly initialized to handle decryption.

Postconditions:
- A `ParquetMetadata` object is returned, containing the processed file metadata and a list of `BlockMetaData` objects.
- Each `BlockMetaData` includes information about row counts, total byte sizes, and column metadata, which may include decrypted information if applicable.

Invariants:
- The method maintains the integrity of the input `parquetMetadata` and does not modify it.
- The structure of the returned `ParquetMetadata` object is consistent with the input metadata, reflecting the same schema and row group organization.

Exception:
- Throws `IOException` if an I/O error occurs during metadata processing.
- Throws `ParquetDecodingException` if column chunks in the same row group are found to be in different files.
- Throws `ParquetCryptoRuntimeException` if there are issues with decryption, such as missing keys or metadata.
bug_summary: The column-metadata AAD is built with the row-group ordinal and column ordinal interchanged. This causes footer-key metadata decryption to fail whenever the row-group and column ordinals differ, while leaving cases where the ordinals happen to match unaffected.

validation_result.reason: The buggy code swaps the row-group ordinal and column ordinal when constructing the ColumnMetaData AAD for footer-key-encrypted columns with an unencrypted footer. The original uses (rowGroup.ordinal, columnOrdinal), while the buggy version uses (columnOrdinal, rowGroup.ordinal). For inputs with such encrypted metadata, this produces a different AAD and can cause decryption/authentication to fail or use incorrect metadata, creating an observable behavioral difference.
